fields.System.Title: INB-204 — Record a short receipt with a reason
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a receiving clerk, I want to record that less arrived than expected, so that the
shortage is attributed to the supplier rather than appearing as warehouse loss later.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a quantity below what the ASN expected, then a shortage reason code is required.
  • - Given the short line is closed, then the ASN line's outstanding quantity is closed
  • short, not left open indefinitely.
  • - Given the clerk expects the balance to follow, then the line can instead be left open
  • for a later delivery.
  • - Given a short receipt, then a discrepancy record is created against the supplier.
  • - Given the confirmation, then only the quantity actually received becomes stock.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | inbound |
| Tables | receipt_line, asn_line, discrepancy |
| Risks | Shortages recorded as warehouse loss instead of supplier shortfall |
| Tests | unit · integration |
